thread:
Maria C.: quick question — I uploaded the Cost Kiosk prototype to sandbox. It shows per-invocation "effective_cost" and a separate line for cache savings. wondering whether we should show negative numbers (i.e. net cost < 0) when cache saves more than gross?
Priya N.: hmm negative in a billing UI feels scary. users might think we're paying them :sweat_smile: maybe show gross + a separate "cache savings" row and compute net only in tooltip
Jamal O.: agree with Priya. also we need to be careful with sampling noise — cache credits are inferred from KV hits sampling, not exact for every invocation
Luke: UX idea — show both: "Gross tokens / unit cost" then a compact "(-) cache savings" and final "Net" but make net secondary (lighter text). adds more clarity.
Maria C.: API debate: should the internal /costs endpoint return precomputed net_cost or components array? right now proto returns components: [model_tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cache_saved_tokens, model_sku]
Priya N.: components are better for downstream slices and charts. but consoles will need to aggregate carefully (don’t sum cache_savings across sampled rows without scaling)
Jamal O.: +1 for components. if we return components we can also expose `cache_confidence` to help UI decide when to display savings vs "estimate" badge
ops-bot: deploy finished: cost-kiosk v0.3 -> sandbox (sha: d4c3f2) :white_check_mark:
Maria C.: rollout question: we want to release kiosk to 10% of orgs, but we have sticky routing that pins some tenants to dedicated SKU. how to show model-level unit econ when routing overrides cheaper fallback?
Luke: show the observed path for the invocation. UI can surface a small chevron: Model served: "gpt-large-1 (fallbacked from gpt-neo-quant)". Also show hypothetical cost if fallback had not occurred (a what-if calc)
Priya N.: that what-if requires us to run a model-cost simulation in analytics path — doable offline. but need a consistent mapping of model_sku -> unit_price that matches billing ledger
Jamal O.: telemetry note: need to tag every request with `routing_decision` and `fallback_reason` so we can roll back rollouts if cost spikes appear. also add `cache_key_bucket` to tie savings to prefix popularity
Maria C.: good call. also, for quotas: when tenant hits quota, we want kiosk to show "projected days until quota" based on 7d rolling burn. prefer to compute on server and include `quota_projection_days` field
Luke: small data-protection thing — some customers treat per-invocation token breakdown as sensitive. we should add a flag `expose_detailed_costs` in org settings and hide components if false
Priya N.: ok API schema sketch idea (proto-ish):
message CostComponents {
  string model_sku = 1;
  int64 model_tokens = 2;
  int64 cache_saved_tokens = 3;
  double cache_confidence = 4;
  double unit_price_per_token = 5;
  double net_cost = 6; // optional
}
Maria C.: perfect. next steps: Jamal to add telemetry fields + sampling notes, Priya to wire UI to components with "estimate" badges, Luke to update rollout plan to include fallback visibility. I'll flip a 10% flag after sandbox smoke.
Jamal O.: on it. I'll also add a small dashboard for "observed vs simulated cost delta" to catch regression from routing policy changes
ops-bot: reminder: weekly infra sync at 10am Wed — add Cost Kiosk rollout status to agenda
Maria C.: thanks all, will post short runbook once flagging is wired.
